note_text:
CC: follow up plantar fasciitis with new lateral foot pain

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to multiple painful calluses. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with multiple painful calluses; general inspection of the foot otherwise unremarkable.

MDM: addressed the procedure as well as a separate complaint; considered conservative options for the separate complaint and deferred a decision.

Procedure: Paring of multiple hyperkeratotic lesions performed (LT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
